pos.personaBrief: Inter keep at least an equal share of the ball (Coaches' Voice) yet are direct in transitions and counter with pace (Flashscore, Ekkono); they do not cede the ball on purpose.

pro.personaBrief: Build-up is fluid, from the back through Calhanoglu and with line-breaking passes from centre-backs (FotMob, Coaches' Voice), but 2023/24 became more vertical and direct after Brozovic left (Total Italian Football, Ekkono).

est.personaBrief: Fixed 3-5-2 with clear phases, but fluid rotations: midfielders drop into the back line, centre-backs push up and Thuram drops deep (FotMob, Flashscore).

lar.personaBrief: No wingers, but wing-backs delivered the most crosses in Serie A 2023/24 and crosses were the top goal source (Coaches' Voice, Inter.it); the central pair of forwards and the midfield trio are the core.

blo.personaBrief: Mid-block 5-3-2 with a wide pressing trap, but also a high press and counter-press (Coaches' Voice, Total Italian Football, Inter.it); forwards screen the pivot.

mar.personaBrief: No verified marking evidence; from general knowledge Inter defended mostly zonally in open play with a mixed set-piece scheme, consistent with the verified compact 5-3-2 block.

pla.personaBrief: Inzaghi kept the same 3-5-2 and way of playing while adapting within games (Flashscore: no single style, adapts to situations), and the team continued to play the same way (FotMob).

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic title winners with the best defence in Europe (Inter.it), entertaining yet result-driven; plays to win away and closes games with extra defenders.

sis.personaBrief: A drilled system with defined roles made cheap signings and free transfers excel (FotMob, Flashscore), and stars follow their roles.

jog.personaBrief: Technical midfield (Calhanoglu, Barella, Mkhitaryan) but athletic wing-backs and an intense, physical team (Total Italian Football, Dimarco and Dumfries).

bas.personaBrief: Built on experienced signings and free transfers (Sommer, Pavard, Acerbi, Thuram, Mkhitaryan, Calhanoglu), with some young talent added; veterans started.

lid.personaBrief: Inzaghi stresses a united group where players care for each other (Inter.it, Dec 2023) and a calm man-management style with wide rotation.
